name: Open Facilitator Gateway
description: Installs the ofac-gateway runtime (self-contained Node bundle), the headless supervisor entrypoint, and a unit that runs a team-owned Gateway against the workspace mount.

configPath.description: Gateway config file the supervisor unit starts with. The OFAC_* env surface and GATEWAY_CONFIG still win at runtime; secrets never go through options.

log.description: Gateway log level for the supervisor unit (OFAC_GATEWAY_LOG overrides at runtime).
